Why this exists

A training space made only for women.

So many women hold back in the gym — worried about being watched, judged, or simply not knowing where to start. I built this space to remove all of that. It's just you, me, and a plan built for exactly where you are: whether that's your first ever session, coming back after a break, training around your cycle, or working through pregnancy, postnatal recovery, or perimenopause.

No comparing yourself to anyone else. No confusion about what to do. Just steady, honest progress — with someone genuinely in your corner.

What makes it different

Built for how women actually train.

Every part of this programme is designed with your body and your life in mind — not a one-size-fits-all plan borrowed from somewhere else.

Good to know

A few questions, answered.

Everything you'd want to know before that first conversation.

Where do sessions actually take place?+

Wherever suits you best. Choose from strength training at the gym in Arnos Grove, an outdoor session for a more holistic, open-air approach, or one-to-one at a PT studio near your address. Please note: I travel within a 5 mile radius only.

I've never trained before — is that a problem?+

Not at all. Most of the women I coach start as complete beginners. Every programme starts from exactly where you are, with technique and confidence built up at your pace.

Can training work around my cycle, pregnancy, or menopause?+

Yes — this is central to how I coach. Programming is adapted to your hormones, energy, and stage of life, whether that's cycle-aware training, postnatal return to exercise, or perimenopause and beyond.

How much support do I get between sessions?+

1:1 clients get direct support between sessions so you're never left guessing what to do next, plus regular check-ins to track progress and adjust your plan.

What happens after my free consultation?+

No pressure and no obligation. If it feels right, we'll map out your programme and get a first session booked in. If it's not the right fit, that's completely fine too.
